_comment: The figure-free floor (2026-10-12). A STATIC scene: no children are drawn in it and it has no tap targets, so it fits any household — any number of children, or none — and registerBaselineScenes approves it on every database. It reuses the idle band's picture rather than committing a second copy. Static manifests rank oldest at registration, so it is older than every other baseline and anything a parent approves; it shows only when nothing else on the wall is usable. The rail does the navigating on a backdrop.
